aboutLead: I'm a Software Developer in Nashik, building dynamic, responsive web applications.
aboutParagraphs: I have 2 years of experience with C#, ASP.NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Web Forms and ReactJS, building RESTful Web APIs and optimizing SQL Server databases.
I work with Entity Framework, LINQ and Dependency Injection on the backend and modern frontend frameworks on the client, to deliver robust full-stack solutions.

whatIDo: ASP.NET Core, MVC and Web Forms backends with component-driven ReactJS frontends, including hospital management workflows.
Asynchronous Web APIs with Dependency Injection, plus WCF and Windows services for core business logic.
Stored procedures, LINQ and ADO.NET queries tuned to improve execution performance and reduce data latency.
Client/server validation pipelines, PDF/Excel invoices and quotations, and interactive reporting dashboards.

bullets: **Developed full-stack hospital management modules** using ASP.NET Core, C# and ReactJS, delivering responsive component-driven UIs for complex healthcare workflows.
**Designed and optimized SQL Server stored procedures and LINQ queries**, improving execution performance and reducing data latency.
**Built asynchronous RESTful APIs** using ASP.NET Web API with Dependency Injection to enable seamless integration with Aras PLM systems.
**Implemented client/server validation pipelines** using Data Annotations and custom business rules.
**Engineered enterprise web applications and RESTful APIs** using ASP.NET MVC, Web Forms and C# to streamline data processing and user workflows.
**Built and integrated WCF web services and Windows desktop services** to process core business logic and transaction data.
**Optimized application performance and user interfaces** across multi-tier client-server environments.
**Developed RESTful APIs** using Express.js integrated with MySQL databases running on XAMPP.
**Designed dynamic ReactJS user interfaces** styled with Bootstrap and Tailwind CSS, maintaining full cross-device responsiveness.
**Integrated front-end components with back-end APIs** using Axios for stateful, real-time asynchronous updates.
**Architected Node.js and Express.js backend services** with custom middleware for routing, error handling and ReactJS integration.
